[[File:Exit_icedome.JPG|thumb|right|A group about to leave Talus Chute.]] *These quests will affect the [[spawn]]s in this area: **[[Seeking The Seer]] *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 395|low = 375|high = 420}} **There are hidden Azure Shadows in the northwestern corner of the map. **Two groups of Tundra Giants are easy to miss. Both patrol a long route using the mountain top path on the westernmost side of the map - one patrols clockwise, the other counter-clockwise. **There are many forms of knock down in this area, between [[Giant Stomp]] and [[Water Trident]]. Bringing anti-knockdown skills can be a huge help. **A roaming group of Avicara may also lengthen your vanquish, they range over an area south and east of the nametag on the map. *Low-level creatures usually encountered in the [[Northern Shiverpeaks]] can be found wandering about various places in solitude. They have no special abilities that distinguish them from other low-level monsters, and do not appear to have any purpose or relation to any quest. In hard mode, their levels and skills are adjusted to a degree appropriate for the area, but they are still alone. *The "troll cave" can be found to the west of Droknar's Forge, which contains many Mountain Trolls and two Troll bosses. It was once a popular spot for [[farm]]ing. *It is possible to reach the edge of the map in the eastern Talus Chute. The terrain abruptly ends, with the sky and ocean visible beyond it. This [[end of the world|"edge of the world"]] bug is an artifact of the way [[w:DirectX|DirectX]] renders the world. It exists in all areas, but most have obstructions to prevent players from seeing it. {{bug|There is a group which can [[patrol]] through the Icedome [[portal]] and get stuck there, making vanquishing impossible.}} ==Trivia== {{gw2w|Talus Waterslide}} *Talus is a word meaning rocky debris at the base of hills, cliffs, or valleys. {{Explorable areas in the Southern Shiverpeaks}} [[de:Talusschnelle]]
